_about: AEW 2026 schedule EXCEPTIONS to the standing slots, and the standing slots themselves. THE WBD MONTHLY HBO MAX SCHEDULE IS THE ONLY AUTHORITY for AEW's night and network - docs/research/aew.md section 1 and section 5 both say so, because Collision moves both - and it could not be reached: press.wbd.com answers 200 but carries no AEW content at its root, and neither pwmania.com nor ewrestlingnews.com republished a monthly schedule on the day this ran. So the SLOT DEFAULT path ran, and every generated episode is tiered `slot_default` to say so. The exceptions below are the ones docs/research/aew.md recorded from the September schedule; each carries its own citation. A later WBD parse supersedes this file rather than merging with it. EDITABLE BY JOE: an entry here overrides a generated episode on the same date.
_slots_source: allelitewrestling.com states both standing slots verbatim: "Dynamite airs every Wednesday night 8e/7c on TBS + Simulcasted on HBO MAX" and "AEW Collision airs every Saturday at 8e/7c on TNT + Simulcasted on HBO MAX". Recorded at tests/fixtures/aew_slots.html.
